title: 3.0.0.2 dev-n TDD not agree with pump
body:
3.0.0.2 dev-n TDD on Action Tab
In 2 days of the 7 the TDD in AAPS did not agree with the  pump. 
One day had a red line the other day had exactly the same data and both about half that in the pump pump?  Pump on 1st =25.1U & 30th=19.6U. See attached picture.  Insight pump.  Phone updated to Android 12 noon on 2nd. History/reason: Running dISF last night I was constantly  below target and dISF sensitivity 1.22 so AAPS had reduced target, increased basal and ever growing negative IOB.  Looking at the tab I suspect this was due to my slightly higher TDD the day before and a lower weekly TDD due to the wrong entries.  NB  I do seem to get more AAPS restarts with dev-n assuming the pump TDD is read near midnight then doesn't seem to correlate.
Samsung A41, xDrip, Patched LibreLink.
